description: Core APIs (events for PTY streaming, window) + native folder dialog + open external URLs (any http(s) link, handed to the OS default browser — non-web schemes like file:// stay blocked) + scoped HTTP to the Chief API. The 'main' app window, the helper-island and capture webviews, and up to four 'project-N' SATELLITE windows (a project tab torn out onto another monitor — columns 2+3 only, one project each, no concierge and no control listener). Satellites use a FIXED LABEL POOL, never a glob: the pool is enumerated in src/project_window.rs and the two must stay in lockstep. A window whose label is absent here gets ZERO permissions, including event.listen — which is silent until runtime. core:window:default only grants the READ side of the window API, so every mutation the frontend calls needs an explicit core:window:allow-set-* entry below — a missing one type-checks and passes CI, then no-ops at runtime (see windowCapabilities.test.ts). Satellite creation/geometry/teardown are driven from RUST (project_window.rs), which is why set-position/set-size/close stay retired here.
